scripts.dev: NODE_ENV=dev npm run config && cd app && npm run dev
scripts.build: npm run config && cd app && npm run build && cd ../
scripts.preios: cd app && npm run build && cd ../ && rm -r ./mobile/build && cp -R ./app/docs/. ./mobile/build
scripts.ios:open: cd mobile && npx cap open ios
scripts.ios: npm run config && cd mobile && npx cap run ios
scripts.ios:dev: NODE_ENV=dev npm run config && cd mobile && npx cap run ios
scripts.predesktop: cd app && npm run build && cd ../ && rm -r ./desktop/app && cp -R ./app/docs/. ./desktop/app
scripts.dev:ios: cd mobile && npx cap open ios
scripts.start: concurrently "yarn dev:config" "yarn dev:app" && wait-on http://localhost:5170 && npm run dev:desktop
